subject: Short sponsorship while PO processes — CureBridge pilot

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@curebridge.com>

Cc: CureBridge Procurement <procurement@curebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short sponsorship while PO clears

Hi Michael,

Quick context — we're in the middle of getting a PO over the finish line with legal/finance and it looks like the earliest they can release it is early next week. The pilot with our clinical team is live and we risk losing momentum if access lapses.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a short sponsorship/voucher (7 days) to keep the sandbox active while the PO clears?
- If yes, any required sign-off/doc we should return to you to formalize it?

I've attached our internal PO estimate so you can see the committed scope. We absolutely intend to convert to a paid contract once procurement approves.

Attachments: curebridge_po_estimate.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility here.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Strategic Procurement
CureBridge

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short sponsorship while PO clears

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the estimate. Totally understand the need to keep the pilot running.

We can provide a 7-day evaluation voucher that will keep your sandbox and the pilot cluster active. A couple of operational details:
- Voucher covers hosted inference credits only (tokens/embeddings used by the pilot).
- It will be applied immediately and will expire 7 days after activation.
- We’ll need an internal approval from Sales Ops to release the voucher and a short confirmation from your side saying the pilot will convert once PO is approved.

If that's workable, I can queue the voucher today. Please confirm and, if possible, reply with the procurement contact who will sign the short acknowledgement.

I’m CC’ing Naomi (Customer Success) and Ben (Sales Ops) to expedite internal sign-off. I’ll attach the voucher stub for your records once Sales Ops signs off.

—Michael
Michael Grant
